purpose: Identify shared repository and control-plane write resources. Isolated RUNNER_TEMP artifacts are explicitly separated from repository resources; this audit remains partial for unrelated writers.

evidence_scope.limitation: The active Source Discovery → Assessment DAG is scoped to runner-local immutable artifacts and a fenced Issue #315 checkpoint. The production repository publisher remains restricted to rulesets/**. Static/transitive inventory for unrelated capabilities, dynamic path aliases, third-party Action effects and all cross-workflow runtime combinations remains partial; those capabilities remain deny-by-default.

isolated_ephemeral_outputs.verification: The main registry and candidate matrix are read-only. The effective merged registry, activation log and report remain under RUNNER_TEMP; the exact registry path is exported to the same audit run and consumed by collect_domains.py. No source registry or activation log is committed.
producer identity + complete logical-document SHA-256 + immutable Actions artifact
default path outside repository; queue_lock and atomic_write resolve paths and reject repository-local, symlink-to-repository and hard-linked paths; adapter and orchestration disabled

evidence_scope.note: Production deliverables are the three standalone DIRECT, PROXY and REJECT rule sets. Queue/checkpoint state, immutable Actions artifacts and runner-local audit outputs are separate control-plane/runtime resources and are inventoried independently.

modules/uu.conf.enforcement_evidence: task_scheduler protected-config digest guard and auto_sync publish-job pre/post staging checks
modules/uu.conf.scheduling_rule: Any detected modification must fail closed; no capability may claim write ownership.

resource_groups.lock_key: read-only main-branch source registry and activation baseline
resource_groups.note: The committed source registry is read-only. Newly discovered DIRECT/PROXY sources may enter a runner-local effective registry only after deterministic evidence, stability and parser gates. Newly discovered REJECT sources are always held for explicit human approval and are never auto-activated. The effective registry, activation log and report remain under RUNNER_TEMP; no repository source registry or activation log is committed.

collect_domains and import_request_observations now call write_document(..., lease_required=True) for the shared data/domain_candidates.json document; collect_domains also fences data/candidates.json, data/source_pending.json and dynamic source snapshots. restore_automation_state restores only into the isolated workspace and never publishes these files.

deterministic_review writes the logical review ledger through write_document(..., lease_required=True); restore_automation_state restores prior state only to the isolated audit workspace and does not publish it.

The durable queue is control-plane state stored as append-only, compressed GitHub Issue #315 comments. Each snapshot is SHA-256 chained to the prior revision; concurrent duplicate revisions resolve deterministically by earliest canonical comment ID. The repository automation/task_queue.json file is read-only bootstrap state. Local task_queue_runtime is runner-local only.

Per-URL results are stored only in the currently claimed task's assessment_checkpoint. Each mutation uses the append-only Issue #315 snapshot CAS and validates task identity, active task lease, exact predecessor run/digest and both logical resource fencing tokens. No repository assessment document is written or published.
lifecycle_gate.py now explicitly asserts the exact rulesets/lifecycle_state.json lease before every state write; lifecycle audit and restore paths share the same production lease.

The selector is disabled and has no production workflow edge. Its script now asserts both exact live resource leases immediately before the corresponding output directory/file mutations. It cannot publish these reports; publication remains rulesets/** only.

resource_groups.lease_key: read-only config baseline; runner-local proposal artifact only
resource_groups.note: register_config_baseline.py verifies owner-authored modules/uu.conf changes and emits a review proposal only under RUNNER_TEMP. auto_sync uploads the proposal as an immutable artifact before verify_baseline fails closed on an unregistered change. It never writes sources/policy.json, release_manifest.json, production_workflow_map.json or resource_write_sets.json. No production writer is registered.

The audit writes sources/policy_source_overlap.json and reports/policy-source-overlap.md only in the isolated runner workspace. Immutable Actions audit artifact preserves them; publish allowlist is rulesets/** only.

All ruleset writers run under the Watchdog logical/production-pipeline lease and explicitly assert the exact output path lease before each published-file mutation. The archive restore path is rulesets-only and asserts each exact path. No global file guard is used.

resource_groups.lock_key: per-run isolated workflow workspace; no shared repository resource
resource_groups.note: All reports are written only to the current audit runner workspace and included in the immutable Actions audit artifact. restore_publish_outputs has a separate rulesets/** allowlist. Production commits are limited to rulesets/**.

resource_groups.lock_key: shadowrocket-domain-intake workflow concurrency group + append-only Issue #317 comments
resource_groups.note: The request-intake workflow serializes all runs through the fixed shadowrocket-domain-intake concurrency group with cancel-in-progress:false, then appends run-ID-tagged Issue #317 batches. Downstream merge is idempotent by run ID.

deterministic_review asserts exact leases for sources/domain_reviews.json and sources/review_cursor.json at each write boundary. Failed/cancelled cursor recovery is retained only as immutable Actions artifacts; the dormant recovery utility is RUNNER_TEMP-only and rejects repository destinations. No cursor-only Git publication exists.

build_rule_provenance now calls write_document(..., lease_required=True), which reasserts the exact canonical document lease across legacy file, manifest, shard, staging and cleanup mutations. Restore is runner-local only; no non-ruleset repository publication.

resource_groups.lock_key: logical/production-pipeline + exact conflict archive/review queue path leases
resource_groups.note: Builder, config-conflict synchronization and archive restoration assert exact output leases before mutation.

resource_groups.lock_key: logical/production-pipeline + exact lifecycle observation/archive path leases
resource_groups.note: lifecycle_audit.py asserts each exact path before write; restore_publish_outputs asserts the same exact path for archive restore.

auto_sync refresh asserts the exact live manifest resource lease. Watchdog manifest-integrity job is serialized with auto_sync by the same job-level shadowrocket-main-writer concurrency group (cancel-in-progress:false).
Exact per-file writer coverage and indirect writes still require call-graph tracing.
The repair script modifies only one of two hard-coded paths, then the workflow stages exactly the selected path and publishes a run-specific PR branch. No direct main write is performed.

paths: path-selected JSON documents and their adjacent .manifest.json / shard files
resource_groups.note: The helper uses atomic replacement, JSONL shards, manifest switching and cleanup. It is not an independent capability and installs no global filesystem guard. Every active shared caller now explicitly sets lease_required=True and the exact canonical document path is asserted before each helper-managed mutation; independent source artifacts and restore outputs remain runner-local.

resource_groups.lock_key: logical/production-pipeline + exact assessment output resource keys in monolithic mode; per-run RUNNER_TEMP isolation in independent mode
resource_groups.note: Independent assessment JSON and report are per-run RUNNER_TEMP artifacts. Watchdog adds a provenance proof binding the exact Assessment task, verified Discovery predecessor, producer workflow run/head SHA and every artifact file digest before immutable upload. Production independently resolves and verifies that artifact; only the bounded task assessment_checkpoint is shared through Issue #315 CAS. No assessment document is committed or published.

build_source_candidates now calls write_document(..., lease_required=True) for the JSON matrix and keeps its Markdown report as a run-local artifact. Restore is workspace-only; no source candidate or report commit.

resource_groups.lock_key: sources/discovered_sources.json + reports/source-discovery.md exact leases in monolithic mode; per-run RUNNER_TEMP isolation in independent mode
resource_groups.note: Independent Discovery writes only to per-run RUNNER_TEMP and uploads an immutable artifact with producer identity and complete logical-document digest. Production downloads the exact predecessor artifact selected by the verified Assessment task and rechecks the digest before lineage audit and source admission. No discovery files are committed; production publication remains rulesets/** only.

Watchdog now re-reads the current Blob SHA and re-merges the same run-scoped paths on each of up to three conditional Contents API PUT attempts. observed_run_ids makes retries idempotent when another run updates the path between attempts. Conflicts after the third attempt fail closed. Distinct runs remain concurrent; parallel-run integration/no-lost-update proof is outstanding.

required_for_additional_enablement: Additional Python capabilities require their own exact release allowlist, typed I/O contracts and independent verifier.
Any future repository writer must declare exclusive resource leases and remain within rulesets/** for production publication.
Global dynamic path, third-party Action and cross-workflow runtime evidence remains required before enabling unrelated capabilities.

limitation: The active Source Discovery → Assessment DAG is scoped to runner-local immutable artifacts and a fenced Issue #315 checkpoint. Per-capability repository writes are validated against explicit exclusive resource_contract.resource_keys; protected modules/** and JavaScript remain unwritable. The production repository publisher stages only the three ruleset deliverables under rulesets/**; this is not a system-wide automation write limit. Static/transitive inventory for unrelated capabilities, dynamic path aliases, third-party Action effects and all cross-workflow runtime combinations remains partial; those capabilities remain deny-by-default.
